quotes.text: For the recorded saved Patch Review capacity error, reopening the failed turn only repeats its stored result. A retry uses `runCodexReview` with the full review prompt after checking that the saved Review checkout hash still matches. A capacity message does not by itself show that account usage is exhausted. Local tests passed, but live provider acceptance was not verified.
